scope: Bounded reconciliation of already recovered original rosters versus exact-model firmware coverage. Target groups are NOT distinct SKU counts. This pass did not request Wayback/CDX.

originalSources.title: 단말기_정보_skt,sti_031014.xls

limitations: Negative directory coverage applies only to saved public indexes, not the whole Internet or all private collections.
Workbook rows are historical document claims; official operator authorship of the GVM Club XLS is not authenticated.
GVM/SGS support does not establish that the built-in game is SGS or that an acquired memory dump contains user-downloaded games.
No new GNEX handset or new playable SGS was confirmed by this pass. CX-800V is an independent BREW recovery.
